data.title: Long-awaited return and surprising absence: Ali Maher announces Egypt squad for the two matches against Malawi | Goal.co
data.content:
Mahmoud Hassan "Trezeguet" features among the headline returnees. The Al-Riyadh man is back after shaking off the injury that ruled him out of the last international break.

Mostafa Mohamed, meanwhile, remains on the outside. The Konyaspor striker has not been considered since the Pharaohs' AFCON campaign last January.

Egypt's squad for the two fixtures against Malawi came as follows: [...] An attacking surprise also stands out. Maher has handed a first call-up to Mahmoud Mamdouh, the Modern Sport striker and the Egyptian league's top scorer with 8 goals, rewarding his impressive form since the start of the season.

Emam Ashour misses out again. The Al-Ahly midfielder is absent for technical reasons, while Al-Ahly Bank goalkeeper Abdelaziz El-Balaoty drops out following El-Shenawy's return. [...] Cairo International Stadium hosts the first leg on 13 November. The sides then meet again on the 17th at Bingu International Stadium in Malawi for the fourth round of qualifying.

Egypt share Group Two with Angola, South Sudan and Malawi. The Pharaohs top the table on 4 points, ahead of Angola in second on goal difference, while Malawi sit third with 3 points and South Sudan prop up the group with none.
